info.description: The pictures a boss's coordinates are measured on. A single type because there is one of each, and they belong to the catalogue as a whole rather than to any boss — the alternative was attaching them to some record that happens to exist, which would describe a relation that is not there. Only maps live here; anything else the catalogue needs a picture of gets a type of its own.

map.description: The hand-assembled map, 3072x4096. A boss's `mapX`/`mapY` and every dungeon plan's rectangle are measured on this one.

wikiMap.description: The source's own map, 3004x3004, which a boss's `wikiX`/`wikiY` are pixels of. Read the size off the file rather than writing it down anywhere: a coordinate whose image size is recorded separately can disagree with the image, and this catalogue has made that mistake once already.
